plain_statement.zh: B13 从 Vaughan 余项到同余计数误差的归约
plain_statement.en: Reduction of the B13 Vaughan remainder to residue discrepancies

brief.zh: 从双侧 Vaughan 余项出发，处理短乘积、大公因数和整除 n 的右侧低段因子。两步长至多 floor(n^(511/768)) 时用加权同余计数误差替代深弧项，界外保留格点计数减宽主弧积分。保留两个方向及充分大偶数的量词。
brief.en: Start with the bilateral Vaughan remainder. Control short products, large common divisors and the low right cofactors dividing n. For two steps at most floor(n^(511/768)), keep the weighted residue discrepancy. Beyond that cap, retain the lattice count minus the wide-major-arc integral. Preserve the equivalence and the quantifier over sufficiently large even n.
